name: REDD+ Forest Conservation
description: Tokenized rights over an avoided-deforestation (REDD+) forest conservation area (ERC-20) — the conservation counterpart to bamboo-plot and turmeric-plot's cultivation claims. Where those two credit NEW planting, this credits EXISTING standing forest that would otherwise be lost: total token supply represents 100% fractional ownership of the area's conservation-credit rights. Roughly half of bamboo-plot/turmeric-plot's universal field pattern carries over unchanged (plotId, location, areaHectares, cooperativeOrGrower, totalShares, certificate hash-pinning, landClass, carbonRegistryBinding, linkedCarbonCreditAssetId); the cultivation-specific fields (species, planting date/geometry, prior land-use baseline) are replaced with what a REDD+ claim actually needs — a deforestation-risk baseline, tenure rights, and a leakage belt. Minting registers a new conservation area's shares against a verified tenure and baseline record (gated behind maker-checker approval, since it asserts both land rights and a counterfactual deforestation claim). Transfers move ownership of the area's conservation-credit rights. Burning retires an area's shares. Freeze places a compliance hold on an account.

plotId.description: Registry identifier for the specific conservation area — enforced unique so one area is tokenized only once

areaHectares.description: Forest area under conservation (excludes the leakage belt — see leakageBeltHectares)

forestType.description: Forest type under protection, e.g. tropical moist, dry deciduous, mangrove — drives which allometric/emission-factor model applies to the baseline

cooperativeOrGrower.description: Managing entity for the conservation area — community forest-rights holder, NGO, or forest department (the bamboo-plot/turmeric-plot equivalent of 'cooperativeOrGrower', kept for cross-vertical consistency even though nothing is grown here)

totalShares.description: Total token supply that represents 100% fractional ownership of this area's conservation-credit rights — a holder's fraction is their balance divided by this figure

projectStartDate.description: Date the conservation project's crediting period began — NOT a planting date (nothing is planted); this is when the counterfactual baseline starts being measured against

baselineDeforestationRatePctPerYear.description: The counterfactual: estimated percentage of this forest that would be lost per year WITHOUT the project. This is the entire additionality argument for a REDD+ claim — the direct analog of a cultivation plot's baselineLanduse — and must be evidenced (historical deforestation trend in the reference region), not asserted.

tenureRightsHolder.description: Who legally holds rights over this forest — often contested and the single most common reason a REDD+ project stalls, unlike a farmed plot with clean private title. Record the actual holder (e.g. a named community forest-rights committee, state forest department) and how that right is documented.

leakageBeltHectares.description: Area of the buffer zone monitored for displaced deforestation pressure — deforestation avoided in the core area but merely pushed into the belt is not a real reduction. A mandatory REDD+ methodology requirement (the conservation-side analog of a carbon-credit batch's bufferPct).

redMethodology.description: REDD+ methodology applied, e.g. VM0007 (REDD Methodology Framework), VM0015 (Avoided Unplanned Deforestation)

certificationBody.description: Certification/verification authority overseeing the conservation claim

certificateUrl.description: Off-ledger link to the tenure/certification/baseline-study document (only its hash lives on-ledger)

certificateHash.description: SHA-256 of the certificate (pins the off-ledger document as proof)

linkedCarbonCreditAssetId.description: Asset id of the carbon-credit instrument separately minted against this area's avoided-deforestation claim, if any — the conservation-rights token and its carbon credits are independently tradable, this field only records the link. On the linked credit, set creditType to 'avoidance', not 'removal'.

landClass.description: PRIVATE or REVENUE_NON_FOREST — NOTE: unlike bamboo-plot/turmeric-plot, a REDD+ area is expected to already BE forest, so this field here instead records the land's formal revenue/administrative classification (which determines tenure and permit pathway), not a forest/non-forest eligibility gate.

carbonRegistryBinding.description: Which carbon registry this area's avoided-deforestation claim is (or will be) credited under, if any — NONE, VERRA_VM0047, BEE_CCTS, GOLD_STANDARD. Same controlled vocabulary as bamboo-plot/turmeric-plot's field of the same name, so a cross-vertical registry view can compare all three. Optional.
